cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As junior coordinator, you'll deal with the blocked sink. I'll keep the event running.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran yesterday's event. You promised me a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Senior coordinator, then. Still reporting to me, but you can choose the plumber and supervise the repair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only one available comes after everyone leaves. I'm not waiting here hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll order whatever dinner you want. You hold the building keys and lock up after him; senior site responsibility. Tell me the delivery time and I'll arrange the handover around you.

reason: Make the hierarchy-based unwanted assignment depend on A conceding promoted status and a real dinner/timing condition while adding the late security burden.
